purpose: Current GitHub v17 Tactical-vs-Tactical low-score diagnosis
budgetCaveat: Fixed atomic actions, not timed matches. Long animation and UI decision delays reduce the rounds completed in a real timed match.
timingCaveat: Concurrent games and rule experiments share CPU; thinking times are not isolated engine performance measurements.
coordinateConvention: a17=(0,0), n1=(13,16). White attacks top goal (y=-1), black bottom (y=17). Model shot distance is Euclidean physical trajectory to the half-square goal edge, not simply endpoint coordinate distance.
